title: VMF released capacity reservation, kept as history
description: REPORT-RELEASED-1: a RELEASED capacity claim, kept under capacity-history/ when the live record is cleared (a wave changed, a target changed, or the quota was checked again). The customer report and the Reports page read it beside the live claims; nothing that judges a wave does. One file per reservation: its name comes from the reservation, so a second write replaces the first.

clearedUtc.description: When the live record was cleared, ISO 8601 UTC.

because.description: changed: the wave or a machine's target changed. checked: the wave's quota was checked again.

claim.description: The released claim as it was, in the capacity-claim contract.
